item.title: Ten dead after mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, lockdown lifted
item.description: The community of Tumbler Ridge was put on lockdown on February 10th amid a shooter incident.

item.title: Premier thanks emergency responders, pledges to look at ‘opportunities to learn’ about school safety after mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge
item.description: Premier David Eby was joined by Nina Krieger, B.C. minister of public safety and solicitor general, for a press conference following the death of 10 people in a mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge on February 10th.

item.title: Carney suspends trip to Europe following B.C. school shooting
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney is suspending travel to Halifax and Munich, Germany, following a deadly school shooting in Tumbler Ridge on February 10th.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge schools to stay closed for rest of week after tragedy
item.description: School District 59 will not be reopening Tumbler Ridge Secondary School or Tumbler Ridge Elementary School for the rest of the week after the mass shooting on February 10th.

item.title: Voices in reaction to the mass shooting that left 10 dead in Tumbler Ridge
item.description: RCMP say nine people were fatally injured by a shooter in Tumbler Ridge on February 10th, who then killed themself. Here are some reactions to the tragedy.
